title: Workspace history API: recent chats, rename/delete, auto-title, search history, saved hits, job links
description: Additive backend endpoints for the chat-centred sidebar and composer. Contract in docs/api-contract.md 'Workspace history additions'. Alembic 0004_workspace_history owns schema.
acceptance_criteria: Given chats on two papers, when GET /chats, then items are ordered by latest activity with paper_title, message_count and last question preview.

Given a default-titled chat, when the first question is posted, then the title becomes a deterministic shortened question once, and a replayed request UUID does not retitle; a renamed chat keeps its manual title.
Given an assistant answer still processing, when DELETE /chats/{id}, then 409 CHAT_BUSY; otherwise 204 and messages are removed.
Given the same query submitted twice with different case/spacing, when POST /search-history, then one item exists with the latest spelling and timestamp.
Given a saved paper, when the same work is searched, then its hit carries saved_paper_id, matched by provider record or DOI.
Given an active summary job, when GET /jobs?paper_id&kind=summary&active=true, then that job is returned with paper_id and paper_title.
test_cases: test_workspace_integration.py on real PostgreSQL via scripts/test-stack.py
